chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Ibn al-Barqī, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Faḍl, from someone who narrated to him, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

There are ten places in which one does not perform salat (prayer): clay, water, the bathhouse, graves, the sides of the roads, ant colonies, the resting places of camels, the course of water, saline ground, and snow.

key_terms.مَجْرَى الْمَاءِ: the course or path of flowing water
key_terms.مَعَاطِنُ الْإِبِلِ: the resting places or watering places of camels

ai.seo_question: In which places is salat (prayer) not permitted according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith lists ten locations in which salat (prayer) is not to be performed. It is a jurisprudential text concerning the rulings of prayer-place suitability and the conditions of proper worship.
